about.data_stays_local: Your data stays on your phone
about.privacy_note: No login. Accounts, goals and confirmed balances stay in private app storage and are never sent anywhere. No page screenshots are collected and no full page text is stored. Uninstalling deletes the data.
about.project_note: Browse the project, update the app and see whether Kelsuita is slacking off.
about.title: About
accessibility.disable_in_settings: Turn off Starwish's accessibility service in system settings
accessibility.enable_in_settings_note: After you enable "Starwish · Read Xiaoxing accounts" in system settings, the app can read the text visible in Xiaoxing Ledger.
accessibility.enable_read_summary: Enable page reading to sync balances
accessibility.error_xiaoxing_missing: Xiaoxing Ledger is not installed. Install it and try again.
accessibility.no_public_api_note: Xiaoxing has no public balance API. This only reads the account page you open yourself, needs your confirmation and never syncs in the background.
accessibility.notification_body: Starwish read the balance. Return to Starwish to confirm. Tap to open the confirmation page
accessibility.open_account_page: Open the account page for "%s", then come back to Starwish to confirm.
accessibility.permission_summary: Only within two minutes of tapping Read Xiaoxing balance does it read the name and CNY balance from the account page you open. The result must be confirmed here before a goal is updated.
accessibility.privacy_detail: It does not read other apps, collect screenshots or upload data, and never taps, records transactions or transfers money. If the page layout changes it may stop recognizing text; update by hand then. You can turn the permission off in system settings at any time.
accessibility.read_enabled: Page reading on · read on demand
accessibility.read_help: Tap Read, open the account page in Xiaoxing, then come back here to review and confirm the balance. If the page cannot be recognized, update it by hand.
accessibility.read_privacy_note: Page reading only works for two minutes after you start it, and only for Xiaoxing Ledger. It never taps, edits transactions, opens bank apps or transfers money.
accessibility.read_steps_detail: Open the matching account page in Xiaoxing Ledger within two minutes. Once the page is detected the CNY balance at the top is read, then come back to confirm.
accessibility.recognized_at: Read at %s. Check the Xiaoxing page; progress updates only after you confirm.
account.add_before_goal: Add an account, then set a goal
account.cny_only_note: CNY savings accounts only; credit limits are not treated as savings.

account.error_unlink_first: Unlink this account from its goals first
account.name_hint_detail: Use exactly the same account name as in Xiaoxing Ledger. Enter the starting balance by hand; afterwards you can read and confirm updates.
account.name_must_match: The name must match the Xiaoxing Ledger account exactly; no card number or password is needed.

goal.calc_help_balance:
Current balance: the sum of the linked accounts.
Start from now: that sum minus the starting balance recorded when the goal was created. If the balances drop, progress drops too and never shows below 0%.

Name your goal and watch it grow.

goal.edit_help: Changing a goal's name, amount or date keeps its starting point. Changing the linked accounts or the calculation mode records a new starting point.

goal.error_past_date: Pick today or a later date

system.accessibility_description: After you tap “Read Xiaoxing balance” in Starwish, reads the account name and CNY balance visible on the Xiaoxing Ledger account detail page within two minutes. The result is only applied after you return to Starwish and confirm. It does not read other apps, tap, record transactions or transfer money, and the data stays on this device. You can turn it off in system settings at any time.
